name: Okaa-san no Himitsu
source:
Ken has a beautiful mother and loves her very much.
His father is gone away for the business.
One day, Ken invites his best friend, Tomoya to his house and presents his mother.
Ordinary daily life and action... However, a tragedy starts from here...
